comments.author: fredrikast
comments.body: There are two comparators implementing the same priority order and they already disagree on ties — one more caller picking the wrong one and the queue order silently forks. They need a single shared definition.

comments.author: jonaslund
comments.body: Deduped into one exported comparator with a tie-break test covering both old call sites (run 5255, green). Resolved on my side.
